Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1172
Claimant:
Kyle Hahn
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
May 30, 2025
First notice of loss received on the rear-end collision involving the insured vehicle. The claimant reports a concussion
and is now represented by counsel, so all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
June 10, 2025
Reviewed the police report and spoke with two independent witnesses, who both describe the other vehicle stopping
abruptly and being struck from behind. Photos from the scene line up with that account.
August 6, 2025
Inspected the damaged vehicle. The rear bumper, trunk lid and tail lamp assembly show crush and impact patterns
consistent with the reported speed and direction of the collision.
August 11, 2025
Confirmed with the police and both witnesses that the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time of impact. The
driver is named on the policy and coverage was in force on the loss date.
October 4, 2025
Ran a prior-claims search and found no earlier damage recorded on this vehicle. Records show no earlier injury
claims involving the same body area for the claimant.
October 6, 2025
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who provided the medical summary. The concussion diagnosis and the symptoms
described fit the force of a collision of this type.
October 10, 2025
Reviewed treatment records. Care followed a typical course of rest, follow-up visits and gradual reduction in
frequency as symptoms improved, with discharge noted after recovery.
October 24, 2025
Took a recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. The account of the collision matches what was told to
the police, the other driver and the witnesses, and has stayed the same in every conversation.
November 27, 2025
Reviewed all information gathered to date. Damage, injury and the accident account are consistent with one another,
and nothing points to a pre-existing condition or prior damage. File remains open pending final medical bills.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
